item.title: Absolum's First Free Content Update Arrives Next Month
item.description: Absolumely Fabulous.Dotemu, Crush Guard Games, and Supamonks have today announced that big things are coming to their fantasy 'rouge 'em up', Absolum, next year, starting with the game's first major update.The ver. 1.1 update, 'The Threads of Fate', will launch at some point in "Early 2026" (the studios haven't been more precise than that at the moment), and will bring a healthy dose of new content alongside the usual tweaks and bug fixes.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Terraria's Huge 'Bigger And Boulder' Update Is Now Live, Here Are The Patch Notes
item.description: Bould over.Terraria dev Re-Logic is kicking off 2026 in style with the monster 'Bigger and Boulder' update, rolling out on Switch today.As is so often the case with Terraria content updates, this is a big one. The headline additions are a new crafting interface and inventory management tweaks, a fresh World Seed menu, and brand new Dead Cells and Palworld crossover content. item.title: MLB The Show 26 Skips Switch 2 Release As Sony Sticks With Switch 1
item.description: Batting up in March.With the arrival of the Switch 2, we've finally been getting some parity across the multiplatform sports games across all consoles, with EA and 2K's offerings being much-better than their Switch 1 counterparts.We thought we'd see the same from Sony's MLB The Show 26, which has been confirmed for a 17th March 2026 release alongside the reveal of cover star Aaron Judge of the New York Yankees, who is returning to front for the second time.Read the full article on nintendolife.c

item.title: Ubisoft Increases 'Just Dance' Subscription Prices In The Wake Of Restructuring & Cuts
item.description: Money+.Just a week after Ubisoft announced it was making a huge amount of cuts and cancellations in order to aid efficiency and corporate restructuring, the French studio has confirmed it will be increasing the price of Just Dance+ subscriptions from April 2026.The streaming service, which launched back in November 2022, can be used in-game from Just Dance 2023 Edition onward, and gives you access to even more songs from the series' back-catalogue.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Fatal Frame 2: Crimson Butterfly Remake Switch 2 Demo And Silent Hill f DLC Collab Announced
item.description: The full game launches this March.Koei Tecmo has today released an overview trailer of Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE. As part of this, it's announced a few extra things.Before it launches on the Switch 2 on 12th March, players can expect a demo on 5th March. There are no details about the demo just yet, but it will allow save data to be carried over to the full game.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Scott Pilgrim EX Brings More Beat 'Em Up Action To Switch In "Early 2026"
item.description: Update: It looks like we've got a release date.:We've got some exciting news for Scott Pilgrim fans, with Tribute Games announcing it's teaming up with Universal and the series creator Bryan Lee O'Malley to release an "all-new, action-packed" video game entry on multiple platforms including the Switch.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
